newsitem.title: USA: TRENWICK SEES MODEST 2ND QUARTER OPERATING GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: TRENWICK SEES MODEST 2ND QUARTER OPERATING GROWTH.

text.p: Trenwick Group Inc said on Thursday that it expects to report modestly higher second quarter operating income when it issues its results next week.
Trenwick said in a statement that its earnings per share should reflect a reduction to 12.1 million shares from 13.4 million in the second quarter.

The reinsurance company, which was not immediately available for further comment, reported operating income per share of $1.22 on a primary basis, or $1.05 fully diluted, in last year's second quarter.

Trenwick said it expects a decline in gross written and net written premiums in the second quarter of 1997 compared with the year ago period, since it declined to write property/casualty reinsurance at low rates.
The company also opted to buy more reinsurance protection in 1997 at more favorable terms than in prior years, it said.
Trenwick said it did not repurchase any shares during the second quarter, but it has an outstanding authorization to buy up to one million shares. Thursday, 17 July 1997 21:48:27 ENDS nN17301887
